title: DATACOMP: In search of the next generation of multimodal datasets

bias_targets.methodology: Zero-shot image classification on the Dollar Street dataset, measuring worst-group top-5 accuracy across different household income levels to evaluate performance disparities.
Zero-shot image classification on the GeoDE dataset, measuring worst-group accuracy across six specific world regions (Africa, Americas, West Asia, East Asia, Southeast Asia, and Europe).

Zero-shot face classification on the FairFace and UTKFace datasets to predict race, and measuring harmful misclassification rates (e.g., assigning crime-related or non-human labels) across intersectional race-gender subgroups.

Zero-shot face classification on the FairFace and UTKFace datasets to predict gender, including evaluating differences in accuracy and harmful misclassification rates across intersectional race-gender subgroups.
Zero-shot face classification on the FairFace and UTKFace datasets to predict age binned into distinct ranges.
